title: The Finance Function Is AI’s Highest-ROI Starting Point
author: Pratik Bajoria
excerpt: Structured data, repetitive judgement and measurable output make finance the most defensible place to begin an AI program.
content: Start with reconciliation, close, reporting and document-heavy controls. These workflows are repetitive enough to automate, measurable enough to prove and important enough to fund the next deployment.

title: Why 70% of Corporate AI Pilots Never Reach Production
author: Pratik Bajoria
excerpt: The failure is almost never technical. It is scoping, ownership and change management — and there is a repeatable pattern to avoiding all three.
content: The strongest AI programs start with a measurable workflow, a clear owner and adoption designed into the build. This note breaks down the operating pattern that turns a pilot into a production capability.

title: The Finance Function is AI's Highest-ROI Starting Point
author: Pratik Bajoria
excerpt: Structured data, repetitive judgement, measurable output. A CA’s view on why reconciliation and close automation beat chatbots every time.

title: Build vs. Buy: A Decision Framework for AI Tooling
author: Pratik Bajoria
excerpt: When to license a vendor, when to build in-house, and the hidden switching costs most leadership teams discover far too late.
content: The right choice depends on differentiation, data sensitivity, time to value and switching costs. A disciplined framework helps leadership teams avoid both premature custom development and expensive lock-in.
